entities.name: Dutch–Venezuelan crisis of 1908
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Dutch–Venezuelan crisis of 1908 was a dispute that broke out between the Netherlands and Venezuela after the Venezuelan president, Cipriano Castro, issued a number of decrees that undermined trade with the Dutch Caribbean island of Curaçao.
